mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, title AS title, owners AS owners, change_type AS changeType, description AS description, new_obj_description AS newObjDescription, trigger_scope AS triggerScope, local_route_table_names AS localRouteTableNames, remind_targets AS remindTargets, replace_task_id AS replaceTaskId, DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expireTime, status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS publishTime, is_active AS isActive, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM bi_mgp.mgp_change_notice WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_active = 1 AND expire_time >= CURDATE() ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, notify_count AS notifyCount FROM ssm_change_notice_user_stat WHERE created_by = #{createdBy} AND notice_id IN
#{noticeId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ssm_change_notice_log ( view_id, notice_id, created_by, created_time ) VALUES
( #{item.viewId}, #{item.noticeId}, #{item.createdBy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO ssm_change_notice_user_stat ( notice_id, notify_count, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) VALUES
( #{item.noticeId}, 1, #{item.createdBy}, NOW(), #{item.updatedBy}, NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notify_count = notify_count + 1, updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_time = NOW()
